deploy-bot: [deploy-start] user=Maya env=production components=[runtime, api, console] commits={runtime: v2.4.1, api: a1b2c3, console: release-2026-03-19} change_window=22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary 1/3 -> cluster-7. Tracking: /deploys/1834512345
Maya: starting canary on runtime cluster-7, will validate KV cache warmup + p95 tail.
Tom: watching dashboards (p95, cpu, gpu_util). ping me if p95 > 120ms or error rate spikes.
Sasha: kicking off smoke tests against console and api canary endpoints.
deploy-bot: update: runtime (v2.4.1) -> SUCCESS on cluster-7 (canary). duration=45s. next: api canary on svc-api-1
Tom: saw one 503 spike at 10s into runtime canary, looks like a metrics blip recovered. all green now.
deploy-bot: api (a1b2c3) -> FAILED healthcheck on svc-api-1. status=503. sample log:
```
[2026-03-19T22:12:03Z] svc-api-1 | ERROR | downstream timeout to model-proxy | trace=12ab
[2026-03-19T22:12:03Z] svc-api-1 | WARN  | retrying request (1/3)
[2026-03-19T22:12:04Z] svc-api-1 | ERROR | healthcheck failed: 503
```
Maya: ugh. is this consistent across replicas?
Sasha: only on svc-api-1 canary, svc-api-2 passed healthcheck. rolling request distribution might be uneven.
Li: quick check: api image a1b2c3 introduced upstream-timeout bump. revert candidate = a1b2b2 (previous). we can either pin traffic to api-2 or rollback api canary to a1b2b2.
Tom: prefer rollback to be safe. pinning leaves risky image in prod partial.
Ana: +1 rollback. need note for postmortem: config change for model-proxy timeout.
Maya: agree. runtime & console proceed; hold api deploy and rollback canary to a1b2b2. initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: [rollback-start] target=api canary svc-api-1 -> image=a1b2b2 user=Maya
deploy-bot: [rollback-complete] api canary svc-api-1 -> image=a1b2b2 status=SUCCESS duration=27s. healthcheck OK.
Tom: verified p95 and error rate back to baseline for svc-api-1.
Sasha: smoke tests pass for console + api.
deploy-bot: continuing deploy: console (release-2026-03-19) -> START on console-cluster
deploy-bot: console -> SUCCESS. duration=38s.
Maya: marking runtime and console as promoted. api remains at previous stable (a1b2b2). we'll put a small note in release notes and schedule a follow-up to reattempt api with timeout fix.
Li: creating follow-up ticket: INF-1289 to revert timeout bump and run e2e with model-proxy against staging load.
Ana: adding release note: "Production deploy 2026-03-19: runtime v2.4.1 and console release-2026-03-19 promoted. API deploy (a1b2c3) rolled back to a1b2b2 after healthcheck failures; investigation in INF-1289."
Maya: thanks all. closing thread. :thumbsup:
